description:
`ProfileRegistry::from_json` rejects two profiles committed under `crates/gf2-core/data/tuning-profiles/`: they use schema versions 2 and 3 while the parser accepts version 4.

## Background

Found while writing the acceleration selection how-to.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Every profile committed under `crates/gf2-core/data/tuning-profiles/` loads through `ProfileRegistry::from_json`, covered by a test that enumerates the directory.
- [hard] REQ-02: The directory holds one schema version; superseded representations are removed per `@/inv/canonical-cutover`.
title: ProfileRegistry::from_json rejects committed core tuning profiles
